scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street scene with tall buildings lining both sides of the road, featuring a mix of modern and older structures, including a large white building with many windows and a curved corner, as well as a yellow building with balconies and a flat roof. The street is paved with gray bricks and has a yellow crosswalk, while cars and motorcycles are parked along the curb. Pedestrians are walking on the sidewalk, some wearing face masks, and there are trees and greenery along the street. The sky is blue with white clouds.
scene_analysis.buildings: The white building has a curved corner and is at least five stories high, with a flat roof and many windows. It is situated between two other buildings, one beige and one tan, with a row of motorcycles parked along the sidewalk. The yellow building has multiple levels of balconies and a flat roof.
scene_analysis.materials: The white building has a smooth, reflective surface, while the beige and tan buildings have more textured facades. The street is paved with gray bricks, and there are yellow lines painted on the road.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and trash cans along the sidewalk, as well as a few bicycles parked near the curb.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are several trees and bushes along the street, adding some greenery to the urban landscape.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted along the street, including a yellow sign with black text and a red sign with white text.
scene_analysis.as_resident: This area appears to be a residential neighborhood, with people going about their daily business.
